newsitem.title: USA: Pittston Brink's buys Venezuela unit.
newsitem.headline: Pittston Brink's buys Venezuela unit.

text.p: Pittston Brink's Group said on Thursday that its Brink's unit was the successful bidder to acquire nearly all of the remaining shares of its Venzuelan affiliate for $58 million.
Brink's currently owns 15 percent of Custodia Y Traslado de Valores CA, the largest armored car company in Venezuela, Pittston said.
Closing of the acquisition is scheduled for January, 1997.
It is expected that the transaction will be accretive to the earnings of the Pittston Brink's Group beginning in 1997, the company said.
Pittston Brink's said the transaction will be financed with local borrowings in the Venezuelan markets and, possibly, participation by local investors in a minority interest in Custravalca.

Custodia Y Traslado de Valores CA (Custravalca) also owns a 31 percent stake in Brink's Peru S.A., the largest armored car company in Peru, Pittston said. Custravalca's annual revenues approximate the equivalent of $70 million and the company has been consistently profitable.
